m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Now that we have a functional Cyclolabe and Lux Capacitor, yes, I believe I can create a Streamportal link to Zanadu.
I have already begun work converting an Escape Pod into a small transport vessel.
The quarters will be cramped, but it should serve our needs. If you would assist me, Doctor, the first Pod is almost ready.
I'm a doctor, not an engineer, you gray-blooded Hobgoblin!
Wizard, perhaps I could have your help instead. If you would install the Lux Capacitor and Storm Jewel, I will finish preparing the Pod.
Thank you, Wizard. The Pod's Streamportal modification is complete. We can embark for Zanadu whenever you are ready.
Now wait just a minute. Once we go, are we going to be able to get back?
When we arrive I will construct a compact Streamportal Pad. Once activated, it will be able to stream us back to the Ark whenever we wish.
Then let us go now - I cannot bear to be away from my beloved home one minute more!
We'll deliver you soon enough. But in return, we ask that you help us locate someone once we get there: a Zigi Stardust. Do you know her?
Of course I know the Luminary of the Aethyrium! Wait, have you come to Empyrea at Zigi's behest?
That's official Arcanum business, Khan.
The <ITALICS>Arcanum</ITALICS>? Oh my. Enough talk. Let us go now!
Pod landing successful. Streamportal link between the Ark and Zanadu established.
After years in that dreadful tower, I am home at last!
Zanadu, your king has returned- wait... this is all wrong.
My beloved Zanadu. What cruel fate has befallen you my absence?
Well, I held the fort for you, James. Are we getting out of here?
We shall see.
Wait, who's this?
An old acquaintance who owes the back of your head an apology. Sparck - can you get us to Zanadu?
The answer had better be yes!
Well, we've got a Lux Capacitor and a Storm Jewel for the Cyclo-thingy - help Sparck rig up a Pod and let's get out of here!
